body.value: Every shop Contoso has stopped trading from, named — 16 premises out of the store dimension's 74 rows, one row per shop, over the whole record with no period restricting it; the closing days run 2013-12-05 to 2019-11-03. 9 were annotated 'Closed' by the source and 7 'Restructured', and both are in, because "closed" is the name of the population that holds them jointly. NO FIGURE IS ATTACHED: this is the register of shops carrying a closing day, not what any of them sold. TWO NAMES APPEAR TWICE AND NEITHER IS A DUPLICATE ROW — "Contoso Store Delaware" is two successive premises on site 46 (one restructured away in 2015, its successor closed in 2019) and "Contoso Store New Brunswick" is two on site 7 (restructured in 2014 and again in 2018) — so 16 closed premises carry 14 distinct names over 14 sites. I did not include the 57 shops still trading, nor the online outlet, which carries no closing day and so is not closed under any reading.
